en-US.author: Yicheng Wang
en-US.description: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.
en-US.longDescription: Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
en-US.name: Runner
en-US.releaseNotes:
Runner 0.19.7 is a feature release for macOS, Windows and Linux on top of 0.19.6, with a fix for new chats and missions failing after many completed sessions.
New
- Remote host usage and link health. A window connected to another computer now shows that host's weekly agent usage and a read-only usage popover. The computer picker shows encrypted round-trip latency, slow links turn amber, and older hosts show an update hint when they cannot send usage. (#1229)
- Sign out of Claude Code accounts. Settings → Agents → Claude Code → Accounts adds Sign out, with confirmation and notes for active or native accounts. The account's folder, settings and conversation history stay on disk; Remove still only forgets the account in Runner. (#1150)
- Simpler role configuration. New roles no longer have an Args field, and a role's Command row hides internal permission flags. Existing custom arguments still work and remain editable; runner role create and runner role update no longer accept --arg. (#1253)
Bug fixes
- Keep starting sessions after long use. Finished sessions now release their PTYs instead of holding them until the daemon restarts. This fixes new chats and missions failing after roughly 500 sessions on macOS, and releases retained session resources on Linux and Windows too. (#1252)
- Start a new tab in the recent tab's project. ⌘N / Ctrl+N and New tab preselect the project of the tab you were viewing. After choosing or dismissing the project picker, focus returns to search so arrow keys and Enter work immediately. (#1241)
- Rounded Linux windows. Floating windows with client-side decorations gain rounded corners, a border and a soft shadow. Maximized, fullscreen and tiled edges keep square corners. (#1192)

zh-CN.description: 让 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI 等终端编码智能体在同一个 mission 上协同工作。
zh-CN.longDescription: Runner 是一款原生桌面应用，让终端智能体协同工作。Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor CLI、Grok Build、Antigravity CLI、Copilot CLI 与 pi 可以在同一个任务、同一个 mission 中配合，每个智能体都保留自己真实终端里的 TUI，由 lead 把决策带回给你。Runner 的一切能力都对应一个 `runner` 命令：mission、crew、role、project、chat、session 与 msg 都能在命令行操作，后台服务是 `runnerd`。智能体在 Windows 上原生运行，不需要 WSL，PowerShell 7 为可选。当前状态：alpha，持续发布。原生支持 macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Windows（x64，Windows 10 1809 或更高版本）；不支持 Intel Mac、Windows ARM64 与 Linux。安装程序、应用与 CLI 辅助程序均使用签发给 Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang 的 Certum 开源代码签名证书签名。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Runner 0.19.7 是 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上基于 0.19.6 的功能版本，同时修复了大量会话结束后无法再启动聊天或 mission 的问题。
新功能
- 远程主机用量与连接状态。 连接其他电脑的窗口现在显示那台主机的 agent 每周用量，并提供只读用量弹窗。电脑选择器显示加密连接的往返延迟，慢连接变为黄色；旧版主机无法提供用量时，会提示更新。 (#1229)
- 退出 Claude Code 账号。 Settings → Agents → Claude Code → Accounts 新增 Sign out，确认时会说明对当前账号或原生账号的影响。账号文件夹、设置和对话历史都会保留；Remove 仍然只是在 Runner 中移除账号记录。 (#1150)
- 简化角色配置。 新建角色不再显示 Args 字段，角色的 Command 行也不再显示内部权限参数。已有的自定义参数仍然生效并可编辑；runner role create 和 runner role update 不再接受 --arg。 (#1253)
问题修复
- 长时间使用后仍可启动新会话。 已结束的会话现在会释放 PTY，不再一直占用到 daemon 重启。这修复了 macOS 上累计约 500 个会话后无法再启动聊天或 mission 的问题，也会释放 Linux 和 Windows 上残留的会话资源。 (#1252)
- 新标签页默认使用最近标签页的项目。 ⌘N / Ctrl+N 和 New tab 会预选刚才查看的标签页所属项目。选择项目或关闭项目菜单后，焦点返回搜索框，方向键和 Enter 可直接使用。 (#1241)
- Linux 窗口圆角。 使用客户端窗口装饰的浮动窗口新增圆角、边框和柔和阴影；最大化、全屏和贴靠的边缘仍保持直角。 (#1192)
